title: A 3rd World Embedded Engineer Responds to "RISC-V They Should Have Known Better"
ai_summary:

title: How to tell if your AI platforms’ accounts have been hacked
ai_summary:
• Regularly check account login activity, suspicious email, and notification alerts on AI platforms.
• Verify account recovery methods are up-to-date, including email, password, and two-factor authentication.
• Monitor account password and security token for unexpected login or access from unfamiliar locations.
student_angle: Regularly monitoring AI account security can help prevent breaches, vital for internships in this field.
